text: Plants lose water through a process called transpiration. This involves the flow of water from the
roots to the leaves, where water evaporates from the surfaces of the cells in the leaf.
Some plants have features to reduce water loss. For example their leaves may be rolled or their
stomata are located mainly on the underside of their leaves.
These features reduce transpiration and such plants are called xerophytes.
